cases.markdown:
# O-1A case dossier — Ada Okafor

Ada Okafor works in machine learning systems (retrieval & inference) as Founding Engineer at Lumen Labs. This case argues 4 of the 8 O-1A criteria — Original contributions, Critical role, Published material (press), Judging — using only evidence corroborated online, with 9 cited exhibits. The strongest criterion is original contributions. 4 follow-up questions are still open; those claims stay out of the argument until resolved.

## Criteria argued

### Original contributions — strong

The applicant has made original contributions of major significance to the field: Created tinyrag, an open-source retrieval library (4.2k ★) (verified: Owner & top contributor (61% of commits) · ★ 4,218 · 312 dependents). Each point is backed by an independently sourced exhibit.

**Exhibits**

1. [adaokafor/tinyrag](https://github.com/adaokafor/tinyrag) — corroborated
2. [Contributors · adaokafor/tinyrag](https://github.com/adaokafor/tinyrag/graphs/contributors) — corroborated
3. [Dependents · adaokafor/tinyrag](https://github.com/adaokafor/tinyrag/network/dependents) — corroborated

**Weaknesses**

- Show significance beyond usage metrics with letters from organisations that depend on the work.

### Critical role — strong

The applicant has been employed in a critical or essential capacity for an organization with a distinguished reputation: Founding Engineer, Lumen Labs (Jan 2023 – present) (verified: Founding Engineer at Lumen Labs since Jan 2023; company raised $8M). Each point is backed by an independently sourced exhibit.

**Exhibits**

1. [Experience · Ada Okafor · LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ada-okafor/details/experience/) — corroborated
2. [Lumen Labs raises $8M seed · SF Business Daily](https://www.sfbusinessdaily.com/2025/03/lumen-labs-raises-8m-seed) — corroborated
3. [lumen-labs · GitHub](https://github.com/lumen-labs) — corroborated

**Weaknesses**

- Show the organisation's distinguished reputation (investors, press, rankings), not just the title.

### Published material (press) — strong

Published material in professional or major media is about the applicant and the applicant's work: Bay Tech Review — “The engineer making retrieval cheap” (Sep 2025) (verified: Feature article about her work (Sep 2025)); SF Business Daily — Lumen Labs $8M seed round (Mar 2025) (verified: Funding story names her as founding engineer and quotes her). Each point is backed by an independently sourced exhibit.

**Exhibits**

1. [The engineer making retrieval cheap · Bay Tech Review](https://www.baytechreview.com/2025/09/ada-okafor-retrieval-infrastructure) — corroborated
2. [Lumen Labs raises $8M seed · SF Business Daily](https://www.sfbusinessdaily.com/2025/03/lumen-labs-raises-8m-seed) — corroborated

**Weaknesses**

- Lead with coverage about the applicant personally; company-focused pieces are supporting evidence.

### Judging — moderate

The applicant has participated as a judge of the work of others in the field: Judge, Bay Area AI Hackathon 2026 — 12 projects reviewed (verified: Listed on the judges panel, Bay Area AI Hackathon 2026). Each point is backed by an independently sourced exhibit.

**Exhibits**

1. [Judges · Bay Area AI Hackathon 2026](https://bayarea-ai-2026.devpost.com/#judges) — corroborated

**Weaknesses**

- One judging engagement is thin on its own — add the invitation and any other review work.

## Not argued

- **Awards:** Only partially verified — grand Prize confirmed — but only 31 teams entered. A follow-up question is open.
- **Membership:** Contradicted by sources — listed as a 2024 finalist, not a Fellow. A follow-up question is open.
- **Scholarly articles:** Only partially verified — 6 works, 6 citations on OpenAlex (claimed 10) · 2 works under “Ada Nwosu”. A follow-up question is open.
- **High remuneration:** No public evidence yet — no public salary data (expected) — needs documents. A follow-up question is open.

## Unresolved issues

- Scholarly articles: Claimed 10 citations (Google Scholar); OpenAlex shows 6 across 6 works — 2 of them under the former name “Ada Nwosu”.
- Awards: The Grand Prize is real, but the event had about 31 teams — likely too small to count as a nationally recognized award on its own.
- High remuneration: Claimed $210,000 USD (2025). Salary isn't public — that's expected — so we need a document.
- Membership: Claimed Thiel Fellow (2024); two sources and her LinkedIn list her as a 2024 finalist, and she is not on the official Fellows roster.

## Suggested letter writers

- **Engineering lead at an organisation that relies on the applicant's work** — Independent view of the contribution's significance from outside the employer.
- **Co-founder or lead investor at the applicant's company** — Can attest to the applicant's essential role and the company's standing.
- **Senior practitioner who knows the covered work** — Can put the coverage in the context of the field.
- **Organiser who selected the applicant as a judge** — Confirms the invitation was based on expertise.

## Evidence

9 claims · 5 corroborated · 0 substantiated · 1 unverified · 1 contradicted

scores.reasoning: 4 criteria argued (3 strong, 1 moderate), so the three-criterion minimum is met. The case rests on original contributions, critical role, published material (press). RFE risk comes from 4 open follow-up questions, 1 contradicted claim, thin evidence for judging. Resolving the open questions should lower the risk.
